mapper.select: select id, batch_no, remittance_no, diff_type, local_amount, channel_amount, handle_status, create_time, update_time from cross_border_recon_diff where batch_no = #{batchNo} order by id asc
select id, batch_no, remittance_no, diff_type, local_amount, channel_amount, handle_status, create_time, update_time from cross_border_recon_diff order by id desc limit #{limit}

select id, batch_no, remittance_no, diff_type, local_amount, channel_amount, handle_status, create_time, update_time from cross_border_recon_diff where handle_status = 0 order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into cross_border_recon_diff (batch_no, remittance_no, diff_type, local_amount, channel_amount, handle_status) values (#{batchNo}, #{remittanceNo}, #{diffType}, #{localAmount}, #{channelAmount}, #{handleStatus})

insert into cross_border_recon_diff (batch_no, remittance_no, diff_type, local_amount, channel_amount, handle_status) values
(#{item.batchNo}, #{item.remittanceNo}, #{item.diffType}, #{item.localAmount}, #{item.channelAmount}, #{item.handleStatus})
mapper.select: select count(*) from cross_border_recon_diff where handle_status = 0
mapper.update: update cross_border_recon_diff set handle_status = 1, update_time = now() where batch_no = #{batchNo} and handle_status = 0
